Remark
[solvable subgroups in negative curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0286 ↗ thm:pet-ch6-preissmann ↗ def:pet-ch6-axis-displacement 1. ch6:6.7.20Generalize section 2 to show any solvable subgroup of $\pi _1$ of a compact negatively curved manifold is cyclic. Hint: use torsion-freeness and, by contradiction and solvability, a subgroup generated by deck transformations $F,G$ with $F\circ G=G^k\circ F$, $k\ne 0$; show that if $c$ is an axis for $G$, $F\circ c$ is an axis for $G^k$, and use uniqueness of axes for $G^k$ for a contradiction.
